scope.mainFilm: Selected genuine form/dropdown paths; separate notes distinguish changed and unchanged branches.

comparisonSummary: 2 named computed samples paired, with 0 stable-field differences, 0 disclosed geometry differences and 2 separately disclosed clipping-mechanism observations. Read comparison JSON for scope; source clip lengths and relative time text are not performance or identity claims.
limits: Appearance-preserving refactor of existing styles. This compares the specified genuine revisions and selected observed paths, with no claim of global pixel identity, exhaustive UI coverage or speed improvement.

Native recordings retain their existing frame cadence without editorial speed changes. Recorder lead-in/hold behavior and any capture misses are retained per original source. Selected excerpts are labelled; all selected complete originals remain downloadable.
Full viewport context precedes labelled detail crops. Held PNGs are labelled as stills in captions and provenance; no recorded motion is implied.
No model message, real provider credentials, paid API/resource, real webhook delivery or automation execution was used. Any genuine unconfigured-model or public-webhook warning is preserved.
Dropdown captures use Neutral; no all-five-theme dropdown coverage is claimed.

Only two matched desktop computed samples support control geometry. A phone-viewport query matched a hidden desktop duplicate and is excluded from visible-phone geometry claims; the original observation is retained and labelled.

Clipping moves from inline clip:rect(0,0,0,0) to compiled clip-path:inset(50%). This is equivalent empty painted clipping, not literal declaration identity. Baseline live clipPath was not sampled; actual legacy clip was.
The changed path is the hidden-trigger input and toggle in the collapsed backend popover. Ordinary visible-trigger keyboard/search and phone views are explicitly unchanged-path smoke.
No hidden input was programmatically focused to invent a keyboard path. Only native visible controls were used for the observed keyboard selection.
